title: Slippage check may be inefficient in `deposit()` when `_keepGovRights=True`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In `deposit()` function code checks that `slippageChecker` with the sum of the minted shares `sharesToMint`, the issue is that when `_keepGovRights = True` then the code sends users different sTrsy tokens and there is no slippage check for their values. So even so some of the tokens may be higher than `slippageChecker` but the user may receive unfavorable sTrsy tokens.
